newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU ON BUSINESS DEVELOPMENTS IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: VNU ON BUSINESS DEVELOPMENTS IN 1996.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU made the following comments about its operations in 1996:

CONSUMER MAGAZINES - In Netherlands earnings developed favourably, with both subscription revenues and advertising revenues rising. Leading market positions were maintained. Belgian magazines achieved much better results due to reorganisation and new approach to marketing. British crossword and puzzle magazines achieved better results through cost reductions and successful product launches. East European magazines are starting to perform well due to new launches.

NEWSPAPERS - Profits rose slightly but remained below expectations. This was due to a further rise in paper costs, expenses connected with launch of regional television and one-off costs for mergers of different newspaper titles. Advertising volumes rose six percent.

TELEVISION - TV earnings in Netherlands and Belgium came under further pressure as a result of heightened competition and launch costs. RTL4 and VTM retained strong market positions in Netherlands and Belgium respectively.

BUSINESS INFORMATION EUROPE - Profits rose considerably, mainly because of the strong growth of the market for job advertisements. Trade magazines in Britain and Belgium also contributed to the improvement but results in Italy were negative. Marketing information unit Calyx showed a satisfying development.
BUSINESS INFORMATION U.S. - Profits went up substantially with contributions from units VNU Marketing Information Services and BPI Communications in particular.
